Package library

Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
library.UserManager
public class UserManager extends Object
Holds the accounts and handles registration and login.

Passwords are never stored. Each account stores a random salt and the SHA-256 hash of the salt followed by the password. Students can create their own account; the staff account is created by the system.

Author:
Narmeen Fatima, Faique Mustafa, Usaid Rauf

    • ensureDefaultStaff

      public boolean ensureDefaultStaff()

    • registerStudent

      public User registerStudent(String fullName, String regNo, String password, String confirmPassword)
      Creates a new student account after validating the input.
      Parameters:
      fullName - the full name (must not be empty)
      regNo - the registration number, used as the username (letters, digits and hyphens only; must not be used already)
      password - the password (at least 6 characters)
      confirmPassword - the password typed a second time (must be the same)
      Returns:
      the new account
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any value is invalid or the registration number is already used

    • login

      public User login(String username, String password, Role role)
      Checks a username and password for the chosen role.
      Parameters:
      username - the username (registration number for students)
      password - the password
      role - the role the person is signing in as
      Returns:
      the account that matches
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a value is empty, or the username, password and role do not match an account
